Questions

Before you start

Is this financial advice?

No. It's education. I don't tell you what to buy. You'll learn how things work so you can make your own decisions, or ask better questions of a licensed adviser.

Do I need money to start?

No. You can do the whole course before you invest anything.

Will it work in my country?

The kit is built to be used wherever you live. The checklist walks you through what to look up and ask about in your own country.

How much time does it take?

One short lesson and one small action a day, for seven days. Go at your own pace, and keep access.

What happens after the 7 days?

If you want to keep going, 30-Day Foundations goes deeper, and you can apply for 1:1 coaching with me.
